Fourth, Ravi will submit incident notes to me directly after this meeting — that's already committed.

Fifth, I'm setting a deadline of end of day tomorrow for Morgan to provide input on the record regarding the coordination meeting, the handoff process, and what's needed from the facilitated repair. If Morgan provides input by that deadline, I'll adjust the temporary arrangement accordingly. If not, the arrangement as I've described it stands.

Sixth, I'll initiate planning for a facilitated repair session between Casey and Morgan, to be scheduled before any direct one-to-one handoffs resume.

Does anyone have a concern with this plan before I formalize it?
